queries_run: Starbucks business model transition Back to Starbucks licensed stores China joint venture Boyu 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K: Channel Development was 5% of revenue; large portion runs on a licensed model via Nestlé Global Coffee Alliance; North America 74%, International 21%.
findings.excerpt: Revenues from our reportable operating segments as a percentage of total net revenues for fiscal 2025 were as follows: North America (74%), International (21%), and Channel Development (5%).

channel_business_model_shift.note: Search snippets were paraphrased summaries without verbatim text; China JV (Boyu, closed 2026-03-30, 60/40, stores moved to licensed model) and Channel Development quarterly swings placed in clues.

clues.claim: Starbucks and Boyu closed China JV on 2026-03-30; Boyu funds took 60%, Starbucks 40%; China company-operated stores moved to licensed model.
clues.source: Business Wire: Starbucks and Boyu Capital Finalize Joint Venture

clues.claim: 10-Q (quarter ended 2026-03-29): China JV stores transitioned to licensed operating model; equity-method accounting.
